description: CITISAFE Traffic Incident Dataset for Smart City Emergency Response is a data set deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors Soham Ghadge, Savitri Chougule. "The CITISAFE Traffic Incident Severity Dataset is a curated dataset designed to support research in intelligent transportation systems, traffic incident detection, smart city surveillance, and emergency response management. The dataset contains traffic incident images categorized into three severity levels: Low, Medium, and High. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
